description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for the LibXDiff library, a file differential library. It includes configuration options, data types for files and buffers, and function signatures for diff and merge operations.

methods.name: xdl_diff
methods.description: Computes the difference between two files represented by mmfile_t structures, using specified diff options and output callback.

methods.name: xdl_merge
methods.description: Performs a three-way merge of files based on provided parameters.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_first
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the first data in a mmfile_t structure and its size.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the data in a mmfile_t structure.
